title: Chicken pasta salad
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water as the pack says (usually 10 to 12 minutes), drain and rinse it under cold water so it cools quickly. Leftover pasta works too.
Use cooked chicken, or pan-fry a seasoned breast over medium-high heat for 5 to 7 minutes a side until no pink remains, then let it cool.
Dice the chicken, tomato and cucumber.
Mix the yoghurt with the olive oil, a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper.
Toss everything together. It keeps for a day in the fridge, so it makes a good packed lunch.
